sanitizer.input: Ephemeral stdout from the read command; no unsanitized byte stream was written to disk.
steps: Retain HAProxy configuration syntax from the read-only stdout capture.
Replace inline authorization credential values with the literal <redacted> marker.
Exclude private-key, certificate, htpasswd, bearer-token, and other credential file contents while preserving configuration path references.
Record the explicit NODE_IP and GPU1-presence preprocessing inputs separately from source bytes.
Write only sanitized configuration files and calculate each checked-in file's post_sanitization_sha256 independently.
